summary: The app uses zero experimental, preview, RC, or canary APIs — grep found no unstable_/experimental_ flags or names anywhere, and every Astro API touched (props, params, url, response.status, dynamic routes, node adapter standalone) has been stable for years. It runs on the current stable Astro 7 line but deliberately avoids all of Astro 7's new features. This is the lowest-risk posture possible: nothing to swap if upstream APIs change.
